stem: ![](asset:P000420-stem-1) A table with smooth horizontal surface is rotating with angular velocity of ω. A groove is made on the surface along the radius and a particle of mass m is placed in the groove at a distance ‘a’ from the center. Find the radial speed of the particle when its distance from the center becomes L.

assets.alt: A horizontal disc rotating with angular speed ω, with two radial grooves at right angles and a particle in each; one particle is a distance a from the centre.
